hypothesis: Family/lineage/content-addressed provenance links detect correlated bilingual and chapter/FAQ derivatives even when lexical similarity misses them. Text similarity is only a review aid, not proof of independence or semantic equivalence.
population: Original305 unchanged rows; metadata graph may use all305 public metadata identities/hashes only. Skip private8 and structural evaluation-only12 for text similarity. Do not read cachetools/esp-hal source or evaluation answers.
graph_edges: row to declared lineage scoped to family
row to source revision scoped to family
row to immutable reference hash, when present; retain reference kind/path as metadata
related_family_policy: Record FastAPI/Starlette dependency-related co-group requirement as a future explicit edge policy, not a claim that current305 includes a FastAPI training family or that dependencies alone prove identical text.
lexical_scan: Only nonprivate DEVELOPMENT_QUARANTINE candidate/reference FAQ/chapter prose fields; model diagnostics not targets and excluded from similarity comparison. Compare within language by lowercase alphanumeric token5-gram Jaccard; report high similarity as possible overlap, never automatically merge or split. EN/PT dependence comes from provenance, not token overlap.
